body.statement: For every \(P\in\mathcal M(d,m,\alpha,\beta,s,L)\), consistency, conditional exchangeability, and overlap identify \(Q_1=\operatorname{Law}_P\{Y(1)\}\), with density \(q_1(y)=\int_{[0,1]^d}\eta(y\mid x)\,dx\).
body.justification: The statistical frontier concerns an identified causal law, so the g-formula must be fixed before any rate claim.
body.gap: KennedyBalakrishnanWasserman2023 gives this identification move for counterfactual densities; it is a required reduction rather than a novelty claim.
body.consumer: The identity links every probability reconstruction and categorical sample in the known-design benchmark to the marginal intervention law also targeted by DoubleGen and DecFM.
